title.en: Chapter 19 — The Garrison in the Stockade

sentences.en: We were six in the stockade, and the work was much.
The captain gave everyone a job.

sentences.ar: هنتر وجويس بيجيبوا حطب، وغراي بيراقب.
sentences.en: Hunter and Joyce fetched wood, and Gray kept watch.
And the squire cleaned the guns.

sentences.ar: وأنا بطبخ، وبجيب مي من النبع.
sentences.en: And I cooked, and fetched water from the spring.

sentences.ar: وكل ساعة الكابتن يطلع ويتطلع عالسفينة بالمنظار.
sentences.en: And every hour the captain went out and looked at the ship through the spyglass.

sentences.ar: السفينة كانت مرسية مكانها، وعليها علم أسود.
sentences.en: The ship lay at anchor where she was, with a black flag flying.

sentences.ar: قال الكابتن: راح أحسن مركب ركبته بحياتي.
sentences.en: The captain said: there goes the best ship I ever sailed.
And the squire said: we will get her back.
The captain said: how?
We are six and they are fifteen.

sentences.ar: وأنا سمعت، وفكرت بمركب بن غون تحت الصخرة البيضا.
sentences.en: And I heard, and thought of Ben Gunn's boat under the white rock.
And I said nothing.

sentences.ar: بعد الظهر، رجع الدكتور، ووجهه مبسوط.
sentences.en: In the afternoon, the doctor returned, his face pleased.
He said: I found Ben Gunn.
We sat together for an hour.

sentences.ar: هو مجنون، وهو عاقل، وهو رح يساعدنا.
sentences.en: He is mad, and he is sane, and he will help us.
The squire said: and he wants a share?

sentences.ar: قال الدكتور: بده ألف جنيه، وطريق عالبيت.
sentences.en: The doctor said: he wants a thousand pounds, and a way home.
The squire said: it can be done.

sentences.ar: وقال الدكتور: بس ما حكى لي وين مركبه.
sentences.en: And the doctor said: but he did not tell me where his boat is.
He said: only for the boy.

sentences.ar: وبعد شوي، صار صوت من برا السور.
sentences.en: And a little later, there was a sound from outside the fence.
Silver's voice: you inside!
A truce!
A truce!

sentences.ar: وشفناه، واقف عند الشجر، وبإيده قماش أبيض على عصا.
sentences.en: And we saw him, standing by the trees, with a white cloth on a stick in his hand.
And beside him another man, his hands raised.
The captain said: everyone inside.
No one goes out.
And he shouted: who are you and what do you want?

sentences.ar: رد سيلفر: الكابتن سيلفر، يا سيدي، جاي يعرض شروط.
sentences.en: Silver answered: Captain Silver, sir, come to offer terms.
Captain Smollett said: Captain Silver?
I know no one by that name.
And Silver laughed, and said: the men chose me.
After you deserted us.
